messages:
Sam: Quick sync — proposing a focused thermal/throttle sweep with NimbleHW before the joint announcement. Goal: quantify perf/W and throughput drop at 45/60/80C plate temps and surface throttles.
Anya: +1. Do we have an existing matrix or should we build a fresh one?
Sam: Fresh. Minimal matrix to keep runs < 8 hours each. Suggest: (batch sizes: 1, 8, 32) x (seq len: 256, 1024) x (temp setpoints: 45,60,80) x (kernel: baseline, opt-agg). That’s 3*2*3*2 = 36 jobs.
Matt: 36 jobs looks fine if we parallelize across 6 nodes. Need to capture tail latency P95/P99 and token/s as well as power draw.
Lia (NimbleHW): We can reserve 6 lab nodes next Tue morning (UTC). We’ll stream power telemetry over the lab's mqtt endpoint /nimble/telemetry. Need you to send the exact payload keys.
Anya: For telemetry keys: use power_w, gpu_util, freq_mhz, package_temp_c, fan_rpm, board_power_w. Also include timestamp and run_id.
Sam: Perfect. Lia — can you confirm the mqtt topic and auth method? We’ll pull into our bench ingestion.
Lia (NimbleHW): Topic is nimble/bench/<tenant>/streams. Auth is client-cert mutual TLS; we’ll add Sam’s bench cert to the allowlist by EOD.
Matt: For kernel variants: can we codify the opt-agg config as a small diff? Example flags: 
```
KERNEL_FLAGS="enable_kernel_prefetch=1 optimize_attention=2 reduce_memcpy=1"
export KERNEL_FLAGS
```
Sam: That looks right. Also add: KV_CACHE_PREFETCH=auto for opt-agg. We should run a canary job first to validate telemetry.
bench-bot: CI:bench-run-1991234567 started by Sam — canary job queued on node nimble-03. Logs: http://ci.internal/bench/1991234567/canary
Lia (NimbleHW): Can confirm nimble-03 is instrumented. We’ll tag power rails in the payload as rail_gpu and rail_sys.
Anya: Useful. For analysis, we’ll compute: watts_per_token, tokens_per_second, and perf_drop_pct vs baseline at 45C. Also compute thermal-setpoint hysteresis if any.
Matt: Suggest scheduling the 6-node parallel run as: canary -> subset (batch=1 seq=256 both kernels) -> full matrix. That reduces wasted cycles if config is broken.
Sam: Agreed. Timing: canary Tue 09:00 UTC, subset 09:30, full matrix 10:30. Lia: does that fit your lab window?
Lia (NimbleHW): Yes Tue 09:00–15:00 UTC works. We’ll stream live telemetry and keep the console open for kernel reboots.
Anya: Please add the bench replay seed and sample prompt set we used for prior benchmarks to the job metadata: benchset-v3 (500 prompts). Important for reproducibility.
Sam: I’ll open a PR with the job YAML and the kernel diff, link here. Also attaching the analysis notebook template we’ll use for perf/W plots.
Matt: Can we include a quick checklist for on-call? e.g., 
- verify cert allowlist
- ensure mqtt consumer running
- verify node temps stabilize for 10 min before measuring
- snapshot model weights and config

Sam: Good call. I’ll add that to the PR.
bench-bot: CI:bench-run-1991234567 canary completed — SUCCESS. Artifacts: http://ci.internal/bench/1991234567/canary/artifacts.zip
Lia (NimbleHW): Received artifacts, starting subset run now. I’ll ping here if we see auto-throttles.
Anya: Thanks all. After the matrix finishes, we’ll produce a perf/W summary slide (1 page) for partner comms and a detailed appendix for engineering.
Sam: Thanks — will follow up with the PR link and run tracker. :thumbsup:
